title.narrative: Technical Assistance for Banking & Financial Services - Zambia

description.narrative: The advisors are working with the Central Bank of Zambia on improving capacity to regulate and supervise the Zambian banking sector, with a focus on problem banks. Specifically, the ability of the Bank Supervision Department will be enhanced to ensure the appropriate on-going examination of problem banks; ensure the BoZs licensing process follows prudential fit-and-proper practices; and, ensure the department has a prudentially sound Early Warning System in place. Problem bank supervision policies and procedures will be developed and implemented that provide internationally acknowledged best practices regarding the drafting, delivering, and tracking of necessary enforcement actions. They are also helping develop a comprehensive Problem Bank Resolution Framework, beginning with the aforementioned Early Warning System, and including every step in the process from special or enhanced supervision through final resolution.
